title: SideKick Bubbler Mouthpiece
description:
The SideKick Bubbler Mouthpiece As the name suggests is designed for the SideKick Vaporizer but can be used in other situations.
Its affordable yet a super amazing bubbler mouthpiece! Made with the SideKick in mind, these bubbler mouthpieces are a great way to personalize your SideKick, as well as achieve an incredible, even smoother experience than before!
